The '''Rebel Medal of Resolution''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] badge awarded to individuals who managed to "''defend the Alliance at the [[Battle of Restuss]]''." It was slightly lower in rank than the [[Rebel Grand Medal of Resolution]], awarded to individuals who directly defeated the Imperial occupying force during the battle.

==Behind the scenes==
The Rebel Medal of Resolution appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]]. Because of the player-optional nature of the Battle of Restuss, it is unknown whether the medal was ever canonically issued.
